sql: SELECT ps.set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, ps.est_operations, ps.site_source, st.fei, st.firm_name, st.country_iso3, st.address FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE ps.set_id IN ('29f17423-5787-47d0-a83b-bbdc0198fbfa', '72bc5dd6-6052-4483-9b13-afdeaaa8cc69') ORDER BY ps.set_id, ps.establishment
